I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged those duplicate arrivals on the morning shift. Marcus is in that channel, so he could see it. Thea is also the account's main contact. Dana has owned the account since June 2025, so I told him she's the one to check with internally.
